reason: Adds a dedicated web terminal with persistent interactive local shells for running commands, building, testing, and debugging alongside the conversation.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中集成支持多会话和多种 Shell 的交互式本地终端，用于执行命令、构建、测试与调试。
summaries.en: Adds an interactive local terminal to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, supporting multiple sessions and shell types for command execution, building, testing, and debugging.

capabilities: Provides an interactive terminal in the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Spawns persistent local shell processes through node-pty
Transmits terminal input, output, and resize events over WebSocket
Supports multiple terminal sessions and shell types
